mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebay_listing (sku, offer_id, listing_id, style_id, size, eu_size, title, brand, price, quantity, status, source_task_id) VALUES (#{sku}, #{offerId}, #{listingId}, #{styleId}, #{size}, #{euSize}, #{title}, #{brand}, #{price}, #{quantity}, 'active', #{sourceTaskId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE offer_id = VALUES(offer_id), listing_id = COALESCE(VALUES(listing_id), listing_id), style_id = VALUES(style_id), size = COALESCE(VALUES(size), size), eu_size = COALESCE(VALUES(eu_size), eu_size), title = COALESCE(VALUES(title), title), brand = COALESCE(VALUES(brand), brand), price = COALESCE(VALUES(price), price), quantity = COALESCE(VALUES(quantity), quantity), status = 'active', source_task_id = VALUES(source_task_id)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ebay_listing WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY sku

mapper.update: UPDATE ebay_listing SET status = 'ended' WHERE sku = #{sku}
